title: Sailing trip
text:
- Friendly guides
- Good information about Barcelona and sailing
- It was fun, if we are ever in Barcelona again we will book it again.
- Highly recommended
author: mariorA8722PR

title: Heaven
text: Absolutely spectacular. Our captain Marie was absolutely amazing. The mood the catering to our needs and to make sure it was an awesome experience was excellent. The views were just cherry on the cake.
author: Dagmara_G

title: Fantastic sunset cruise!
text: Absolutely amazing experience! Staff was so lovely accommodated for the occasion! was able to stop off and have a sunset swim. Beautiful sights of the coast line! Thank you so much for giving us a lovely trip!
author: 222tiaf

title: Very nice experience with...
text: Very nice experience with friends, the sunset was really beautiful and the crew was really very nice and friendly  !!
author: Sonia_H

title: Amazing celebratory cruise
text: 11 of us took this trip for my 40th birthday and it was fantastic! The sunsets were beautiful and we were provided with plenty of drinks and snacks to celebrate! We even saw dolphins :-)
author: Laura_M

title: An evening to remember!
text: Our sunset sail was absolutely amazing!  Everything was perfect!  The crew, Ivy and Uney(?), were wonderful!  We couldn't have asked for a more relaxing evening!
author: Randall_W

title: Sunset sailing with the pros!
text: My family of 8 took this Sunset Cruise on Sunday, July 18 and we had an absolute blast!  The 2 crew members, Unay and Ivy, were amazing and their attitude and professionaiism made our experience a wonderful one.  We all loved the way they treated us and I would highly recommend any type of excursion with these two.  Our experience was memorable and they were a big part of that!!!
author: randallswhite

title: Balade aux bateau
text:
Great staff and great boat. Everione very friendly. The boat was impecable!!
I do recomend this activité.
author: Bernard487

title: Great fun and lovely staff
text: Really excellent. Lovely staff, professional. Stopped so we could have a swim as well. Highly recommended.
author: 817tima

title: Great Experience
text: Thank you very much for this experience! I did the 2.5 hour boat trip at sunset and it was magical! The staff is very friendly and allowed us to spend a unique time at sea! I recommend 100%!
author: leabarcelona974
